''' Master Farmers''' are adept farmers that can be [[pickpocketed]] to receive a variety of [[seeds]]. Level 38 [[Thieving]] is required to pickpocket them. Successful pickpockets can result in most types of seeds, excluding [[tree seed]]s and [[fruit tree seed]]s. 43 Thieving experience is granted upon successfully pickpocketing a Master Farmer. Failing to pickpocket a Master Farmer results in being [[stun (status)|stunned]] for five seconds and taking three hitpoints of damage. If the player's inventory is full, they will be unable to pickpocket them.

[[Ironman Mode|Ironmen]] looking for herb seeds can expect up to 60 high level seeds ([[ranarr seed|ranarr]] or higher) per hour at maximum efficiency.

Before reaching 85 [[Farming]], players can expect a decreased drop rate for [[ranarr seed]]s, [[snapdragon seed]]s and [[torstol seed]]s.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1400868684474765314|date=4 June 2021|archiveurl=https://archive.is/587zW|archivedate=6 September 2021|quote=}}{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1460070685678747652|date=15 November 2021|archiveurl=https://archive.md/5xvrY|archivedate=27 November 2021|quote=}}

==Money making==
{{Mmgsection|Pickpocketing master farmers}}

==Pickpocketing==
===Pickpocket chance===
The chance of successfully pickpocketing a Master Farmer scales between 91/256 at level 1, and 241/256 at level 99.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Kieren|url=https://twitter.com/JagexKieren/status/691576301296164865|date=25 January 2016|archiveurl=https://archive.is/nVSVe|archivedate=30 May 2020|quote=Master farmers: 90/255 at lv1, 240/255 at 99.}}

With the multiplicative +10% pickpocketing bonus from the hard [[Ardougne Diary]], players will stop failing to pickpocket them at level 94 Thieving.

{{Skilling success chart|label=Master Farmer pickpocket chance
|label1=Normal|low1=90|high1=240|req1=38|color1=gray|image1=Thief Master farmer.png
|label2=Gloves of silence|low2=94|high2=252|req2=38|color2=darkblue|image2=Gloves of silence.png
|label3=Ardougne Diary|low3=99|high3=264|req3=67|color3=black|image3=Ardougne cloak 3.png
|label4=Thieving cape + Ardougne Diary|low4=108|high4=290|req4=99|color4=purple|image4=Thieving cape.png
}}
